title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Protected Repair Cost, Protection Limit and Excess
content:
This calculation governs the adjustment of a disputed damage repair charge on a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement with damage protection.

## Definitions and rule

1. **Disputed charge.** The disputed charge is the damage repair line the approved dispute names.
2. **When nothing is due.** No adjustment is due under this rule when the approved dispute was filed more calendar days after the return date than the class's dispute window allows, or when the return inspection recorded a damage cause other than accidental, since misuse, loss or theft and tire or track damage stay billed in full. The days are counted from the date part of the return time to the date the approved dispute was registered; the dispute window is the class figure on the overdue, lost equipment and dispute window table.
3. **What the repair cost includes.** The shop's assessed repair cost covers everything needed to put the unit back in rental condition, including accessories not returned and the fuel used in testing; damage protection never covers those and never covers the deductible, so they are taken off before the coverage limit applies.
4. **Protected repair cost.** The protected repair cost is the disputed damage repair charge less the missing-accessory charge, the refuelling charge and the damage deductible standing on the agreement, and never below zero.
5. **Protection limit.** The protection limit of the agreement is the class coverage limit of damage protection, as on the damage protection schedule.
6. **Excess.** The excess the renter keeps is the protected repair cost above the protection limit of the agreement, and never below zero.
7. **Adjustment.** The adjustment is the disputed damage repair charge less the excess the renter keeps, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end, half a cent rounding up.

## Worked examples (hypothetical agreements, accidental damage, dispute in the window)

| Item | Earthmoving unit | Aerial unit |
|---|---|---|
| Disputed damage repair charge | 14000.00 | 4200.00 |
| Missing-accessory charge standing | 120.00 | 80.00 |
| Refuelling charge standing | 69.00 | 0.00 |
| Damage deductible standing | 540.00 | 250.00 |
| Protected repair cost | 13271.00 | 3870.00 |
| Class coverage limit | 10000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Excess the renter keeps | 3271.00 | 0.00 |
| Adjustment | 10729.00 | 4200.00 |

## Points of judgement

- *The inspection recorded tire damage on a skid steer.* The cause is not accidental; nothing is due under this rule.
- *The class window is 14 days and the approved dispute was registered 15 calendar days after the return date.* Nothing is due under this rule.
